overview.title: A spiritual centre inside the walls
overview.p1: The Grande Mosquée is part of Taroudant’s medina identity. Non-Muslim visitors generally view it from the outside; the surrounding lanes and the call to prayer still shape the daily soundscape.
overview.p2: Combine a respectful exterior stop with the souks and Assarag. Dress modestly near religious sites.
